card.name: Gaps and list punctuation in plant lists
card.fires_on: Spaces, dashes, colons and 'The' at breaks between list items, mostly in gardening and vegetable-family lists or heel-device lists. It also fires on a few stray spots such as a decimal point or a date gap.

modes.label: Space between plant family lists
modes.description: A blank space right after a list of vegetables, before the next family heading.

modes.label: List openers in heel-device text
modes.description: A dash, colon or 'The' that starts an item in a bulleted list of heel devices.
